title: AirPush: A Pneumatic Wearable Haptic Device Providing Multi-Dimensional Force Feedback on a Fingertip
content: [CHI 2024] A finger wearable haptic device capable of generating continuously adjustable force feedback in multiple directions using compressed air.

title: VibroArm: Enhancing the Sensation of Forearm Deformation in Virtual Reality Using Vibrotactile Funneling Illusion
content: [ISMAR 2024] A lightweight wearable haptic system with the vibrotactile funneling illusion that enhances the virtual forearm’s ownership in the forearm deformation illusion.

title: VRCaptions: Design Captions for DHH Users in Multiplayer Communication in VR
content: [CHI 2025] A caption prototype for the inclusive and accessible caption system for DHH individuals in VR multiplayer conversations.

title: PinCity: Multiplayer AR system with Shape-Changing Displays for Dynamic Urban Design
tags: Augmented Reality, Shape-changing Display, Haptics, Collaboration
content: [SIGGRAPH Asia 2025] An AR urban design system that enables multiple users to have real-time tangible interaction between virtual urban models and a physical pin-array-based shape-changing display.

title: “Do we need opaque walls?”: Exploring Collaboration Space Design Using Transparency Attributes on the Room Walls in Virtual Reality
content: [IJHCI] A study demonstrates that wall transparency is a critical design concept in VR collaboration, shaping attention, stress, and collaborative experience.

title: SoundWeAR: Co-Designing AR Sound Cues to Support Outdoor Awareness for DHH Individuals
content: [CHI 2026] An AR glasses–based sound visualization system that enhances situational awareness and safety for DHH individuals in outdoor environments.

title: The Effect of Building Typology and Visual Complexity on Stress Levels through Amplitude Spectrum Analysis
